service_boundary: Represents the Cerebras hosted inference service, not Cerebras hardware systems, downloadable models, or customer-operated Cerebras deployments.
regional_controls: The shared API does not expose customer-selected regions in the reviewed docs; enterprise dedicated endpoints define separate capacity and placement arrangements.
retention_controls: Batch input files and results default to seven-day retention; prompt caches are ephemeral. Other request and logging behavior follows the service agreement and feature documentation.
routing: Customers select a hosted model or dedicated endpoint; service tiers affect admission priority rather than upstream-provider selection.
customization: Enterprise plans document fine-tuned models, uploaded model versions, and dedicated endpoints.
strengths: The service is optimized for high token throughput on Cerebras infrastructure.
Shared, batch, priority, and dedicated paths are documented.
tradeoffs: The shared production catalog is selective.
Regional placement and custom endpoints require enterprise coordination.

response_integrity.note: No signature, attestation, or equivalent mechanism for verifying that a response arrived unaltered from the model appears in the API reference or the security documentation.
response_integrity.scope: Cerebras inference documentation, for Cerebras Inference

upstream_disclosure.note: The terms of service state the operator's role over prompts and outputs: "We reserve the right to use Service Content to provide the Service to you, comply with applicable law and enforce these Terms", and that this "does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models". No subprocessor is named; the trust centre's list is behind a request-access control.
upstream_disclosure.scope: Cerebras terms of service, for Cerebras Inference

credential_handling.note: The API offers no customer-supplied-key path: "API keys are static secrets you generate in the Cloud Console and include in every request for authentication."
credential_handling.scope: Cerebras Cloud Console API-keys page, for Cerebras Inference

cache_isolation.note: The prompt-caching guide states: "Prompt caches are never shared between organizations. Only members of your organization can benefit from caches created by identical prompts within your team."
cache_isolation.scope: Cerebras prompt-caching guide, for Cerebras Inference

vulnerability_disclosure.note: A responsible-disclosure policy is published: "We welcome reports from the security community to help us identify and remediate vulnerabilities in a responsible manner."
vulnerability_disclosure.scope: Cerebras responsible-disclosure policy, for Cerebras Inference

independent_audit.note: The public trust centre shows company-level SOC 2 Type 2 material behind a request-access control ("Use this Trust Center to learn about our security posture and request access to our security documentation.") and nothing names the inference service, so it is recorded as undocumented for the named service.
independent_audit.scope: Cerebras trust centre, read for Cerebras Inference
